summary: You begin with the wrong question. Don't write because you want "others to care" write about what you care about and if you push content those who have similar interest will find you. David Shanske is an encyclopedia of cool stuff! Get it out there. Set a challenge to write a 150 words a day for thirty days and go for it!
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
You begin with the wrong question. Don't write because you want "others to care" write about what you care about and if you push content those who have similar interest will find you.

David Shanske is an encyclopedia of cool stuff! Get it out there. Set a challenge to write a 150 words a day for thirty days and go for it!
